_comment: C0-11 正文英译 · wenxin（2026-10-25）。含 name_history 可选轴（build.mjs 585 行：缺它 bodyEnComplete=false）。

axes.model_access: The main line is Baidu's self-developed Wenxin (ERNIE) model series; Baidu Intelligent Cloud Qianfan is the developer API line, another interface from the same vendor. In-app model tiers are per the signed-in UI; not verified while signed in.
axes.runtime: Web (yiyan.baidu.com) + iOS/Android apps + PC client; generation is processed on Baidu's cloud, no model runs locally.
axes.local_files: Chat history is stored on the account side; document/image parsing happens in the cloud. No locally-oriented data surface declared by the official side.
axes.background: Chats return instantly; no official statement verified for an async task-queue form. The product includes "deep search/agent"-type capability lines (seen in the official-site navigation).
axes.tools: In-product capability lines incl. web search (the Baidu search ecosystem is its source differentiator), document parsing, image generation and agent creation; integration with Baidu Wenku (doc library)/Netdisk is part of the official narrative. MCP support not verified item by item.
axes.context: Session history syncs when signed in; no official statement verified for a cross-session memory mechanism (if unknown, say unknown).
axes.permissions: Account system (Baidu account login); the training-use switch path not verified item by item. The Wenxin model filing number is in the cn block (cross-verified against official public disclosures).
axes.fit: Suits: people living in the Baidu ecosystem (search/Wenku/Netdisk), Chinese Q&A + web retrieval, wanting traceable official docs for Wenxin-series models. Does not suit: running models locally (the Wenxin main line does not open-source its weights), or leaving the Baidu account.
axes.name_history: Brand renaming history (dossiers must state it clearly): Wenxin Yiyan (2023 launch) → Wenxiaoyan (2024-09 App-side rename) → unified as "Wenxin" (official wording 2025-11-02) — one product with three names across periods; recognize all three when searching.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to chat products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **The actual form of the in-app model tier selector** (only visible after signing in)
- **The training-use switch path and default state**
- **The data boundary of the Baidu Wenku/Netdisk integration** (integration is the selling point; the boundary needs measurement)
unknowns:
- In-app model tier routing (not verified while signed in)
- The training-use switch path and default state (not verified item by item)
- The cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
- The data boundary of the Wenku/Netdisk integration (not verified item by item)
